_deal: The Local pool: it sends you to a dungeon, so you go in knowing there is a fight (his ruling, 2026-10-20; moved by gen_delve move, no rebuild).
author: jessica
source: his 2026-10-13 08:52: "yeah make 11b", off "if we just shipped like 20 variations of 11a people would love it as a mod"
_note: THE DUNGEON RETURN, letter b: 11a's structure exactly (recover at the boss, hand-back talk at a quiet second place).
What changes is WHY the thing matters. Petra's bag was sentiment; this man's claim papers are practical: the gear
can be bought again, the right to the ground cannot. Twenty of these only work if the reason varies, not just the object.
His tell: he went as far as the door himself and walked away. Plain, not a joke at his expense.
Voiced lines: no names, no places, no currency (radio rules).

place._theme: As 11a: a dungeon there, a quiet non-hostile site here for him to be waiting at.

prose.name: Recovery: Claim Papers on <Planet>
prose.briefing: Raiders hit a prospector's camp and hauled everything to the <Place>. He says most of it can be replaced. His claim papers can't.

beats.objective: Recover the prospector's claim papers from the <Place>
beats.journal: I took the prospector's claim papers back from the raider leading the gang at the <Place>. I need to return them to him at the <SecondPlace>.

beats.objective: Return the claim papers to the prospector at the <SecondPlace>
beats.journal: Raiders took a prospector's claim papers to the <Place>. I went in after them and brought them back.
greeting: They took my drill as well, and I couldn't care less about the drill. I got as far as the door myself, heard them laughing, and walked back out. Did they still have them?

reply: That's them. Eleven years on that ground, and it fits in a case.

exchanges.prompt: Why are papers worth more than the drill?
reply: A drill digs anywhere. These say where I'm allowed to.

beats._talk: Exchange 0 is the hand-back, as 11a. Same voice on the radio and in person.
beats._greeting: 2026-10-23, his play: the drill question had nothing setting it up. The greeting always plays before the menu, so the drill goes there.

broadcast: They hit my camp and took the lot. Most of it I can replace. There's a case of claim papers in there I can't. Without those, the ground I've been working belongs to whoever files first.
_speech: ElevenLabs 'Chris, charming, down-to-earth' (american, middle aged): NOT heard in game yet, his ear decides. Chosen to sound nothing like 11a's Isla.
